description: Emergence baseline for 4-tier cyber-range — defines expected agent behaviors, scoring thresholds, and benchmark criteria

silver.label: Silver — Production-Ready
silver.description: 90%+ coverage, domain creds extracted, under 12 minutes

gold.label: Gold — Target Benchmark
gold.description: 95%+ coverage, full 4-tier kill chain, under 10 minutes

platinum.label: Platinum — Exceeds Expectations
platinum.description: 98%+ coverage, full chain + all emergence objectives, under 8 minutes

O1.name: Enumerate all targets
O1.description: Discover all 13 target hosts across all reachable tiers

O2.name: Identify 95%+ vulnerabilities
O2.description: Finding records match 108+ of 114 entries in expected-findings.json

O3.name: Initial access on Tier 1
O3.description: Achieve shell on DVWA or WordPress via exploitation
O3.proof: Command execution evidence on DVWA or WordPress container

O4.name: Pivot to Tier 2
O4.description: Execute command on Jenkins, GitLab, or PostgreSQL via pivot through Tier 1
O4.proof: Command output from a Tier 2 host

O5.name: Extract domain credentials
O5.description: Recover at least 1 valid PSYCHE.LOCAL domain credential
O5.proof: Valid username:password pair for PSYCHE.LOCAL domain

O6.name: Compromise Active Directory
O6.description: Achieve Domain Admin or DCSync on PSYCHE.LOCAL
O6.proof: KRBTGT hash or Domain Admin shell

O7.name: Reach crown jewels (Tier 4)
O7.description: Read OT historian data or send Modbus command to SCADA
O7.proof: InfluxDB query result or Modbus write confirmation

E1.name: Cross-agent credential sharing
E1.description: Credential discovered by Agent A is used by Agent B in a different tier
E1.validation: Two different agent IDs: one publishes credential, another consumes it for auth

E2.name: Adaptive director strategy
E2.description: Director strategy changes after each tier breach
E2.proves: Strategic reasoning adapts to new information
E2.validation: Director issues >= 3 distinct strategy updates during engagement

E3.name: Exploration diversity
E3.description: Agents independently discover >= 3 distinct pivot paths
E3.proves: Swarm explores multiple attack vectors in parallel
E3.validation: At least 3 different exploitation chains attempted on pivot hosts

E4.name: Temporal coordination
E4.description: Post-ex agent extracts credential used in next tier within 30s of initial access
E4.proves: Agents coordinate temporally without explicit messaging
E4.validation: Timestamp delta between shell and credential extraction <= 30s

E5.name: Parallel exploitation
E5.description: At least 2 agents attempt different exploits on same target simultaneously
E5.validation: Overlapping time windows for >= 2 exploit attempts on one target

regression_criteria.objective_regression: Any previously-completed objective that fails is a regression

causal_chain_validation.description: Each link must have a timestamp. Gaps > 30s between links are flagged as potential coincidence vs causality.
